title: The 6 Best Convertible Car Seats
metaDescription: Our 6 picks for convertible car seats, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at convertible car seats using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Graco 4Ever DLX 4-in-1 Car Seat
products.blurb: Key specs: 4-in-1: rear-facing, forward-facing, highback booster, backless booster, Rear-facing 4 to 40 pounds, forward-facing 22 to 65 pounds, 10-year usable lifespan.
strengths: Covers all four stages of use from newborn through booster in one purchase
Rapid Remove cover makes washing the seat significantly less of a project than most competitors
limitations: Bulkier footprint than the slimmer Britax Boulevard in tight back seats
Booster stage is years away for newborn buyers, a feature not used immediately
Higher weight capacity in booster mode adds bulk not needed in the early years
features: 4-in-1: rear-facing, forward-facing, highback booster, backless booster
Rear-facing 4 to 40 pounds, forward-facing 22 to 65 pounds
Simply Safe Adjust harness with integrated buckle lock-off

products.name: Britax Boulevard ClickTight Convertible Car Seat
products.blurb: Key specs: Rear-facing 5 to 40 pounds, forward-facing 20 to 65 pounds, ClickTight installation with a steel tensioner, Two layers of side impact protection.
strengths: ClickTight install is widely considered one of the easiest convertible seats to install tightly and correctly
Click & Safe indicator confirms harness snugness without guesswork
Two layers of side impact protection is a genuine structural feature, not just marketing
limitations: Does not convert to a booster mode, so a separate booster is needed later
Priced meaningfully higher than the Graco 4Ever DLX
5-pound minimum, slightly higher than Graco's 4-pound minimum
features: Rear-facing 5 to 40 pounds, forward-facing 20 to 65 pounds
ClickTight installation with a steel tensioner
Two layers of side impact protection

products.name: Graco Extend2Fit Convertible Car Seat
strengths: Rear-facing to 50 lb, forward-facing harness to 65 lb
Extension panel lets kids stay rear-facing longer
No-rethread harness adjusts with the headrest
InRight LATCH connectors for quick installation
limitations: Takes more front-to-back room when the extension is used
